finding: The reported phrase 'three-parameter torus ... modulo global phase' is incorrect: the displayed local-phase family has only TWO effective parameters on bipartite operators. Set alpha=theta0+phi0 and xi=theta3-theta0. The bipartite weights are alpha + f_a(delta,xi) + g_b(delta,xi), where f=(0,delta,2delta,xi), g=(0,-delta,-2delta,2delta-xi,-2delta-xi). The alpha term is a global ket phase; theta0-phi0 is also invisible. The effective torus is therefore T^2, parametrized by (delta,xi), not T^3.
